actions.name: Use
actions.area: the caster and all allies within a 30-ft.-radius burst, centered on the caster

description.summary: Tactical acumen grants you and your allies a mastery of battlefield tactics
description.value: Tactical acumen grants you and your allies a mastery of battlefield tactics. Whenever you would gain a bonus on attack rolls or to AC due to battlefield position, such as flanking, higher ground, or cover, you gain an additional +1 insight bonus. This bonus increases by +1 for every five caster levels above 5th you possess (maximum +4).
